title: Cloud Infrastructure
content: Apply cloud infrastructure aesthetic with cloud console feel. Service-specific icons (compute, storage, database, networking). Resource grouping by type or region. Connection arrows showing data flow. Status badges (running, stopped, error). Metrics mini-charts. Cost indicators. Region/AZ labels. Tags and resource IDs. Console navigation sidebar. Cloud-native architecture atmosphere.

variants.simple: Create cloud provider aesthetic with service icons, resource diagrams, and AWS/Azure/GCP styling.
variants.detailed: Apply cloud infrastructure aesthetic with cloud console feel. Service-specific icons (compute, storage, database, networking). Resource grouping by type or region. Connection arrows showing data flow. Status badges (running, stopped, error). Metrics mini-charts. Cost indicators. Region/AZ labels. Tags and resource IDs. Console navigation sidebar. Cloud-native architecture atmosphere.
variants.advanced: Apply cloud infrastructure aesthetic with major cloud provider console feel. Service icons: consistent icon style (AWS orange, Azure blue, GCP colors), recognizable service shapes - compute (EC2 box), storage (S3 bucket), database (RDS cylinder), Lambda (function symbol), containers (docker whale). Architecture diagrams: grouped resources in VPC/subnet boundaries, availability zone separation, region labels. Connections: arrows showing traffic flow, IAM permissions, event triggers. Service colors: compute orange, storage green, database blue, networking purple, security red - consistent across diagram. Resource cards: service icon, resource name, ID (truncated), status badge, key metrics. Status indicators: running (green circle), stopped (gray), pending (yellow pulse), error (red). Metrics: CPU%, memory, request count sparklines, cost per resource. Console navigation: sidebar with service categories, search, recent resources, favorites. Breadcrumbs: Account > Region > Service > Resource path. Tables: resource listings with sortable columns, bulk actions. Filters: status, type, tags, region dropdowns. Tags: key:value badge displays, filterable. Costs: daily/monthly cost column, trend indicators, budget alerts. IAM: role badges, permission boundaries indicated. Logs: CloudWatch-style log groups and streams. Regions: region selector with flag icons, latency indicators. Implementation: consistent icon library, service color tokens. Accessibility: icons need labels, status conveyed by more than color.
